::: {#rem-racket-predicates}
#### Predicates in Racket

A Racket procedure that returns `#t` or `#f` is also called a predicate,
and by convention its name ends in `?`, as in `even?` and `string?`.
The predicate $L(s)$ from @exr-predicate-values is

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(define (long? s)
  (> (string-length s) 3))
```

and it is true of `"logic"`:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(long? "logic")
```

:::
